title: The Glass Eyes
text: A jar of glass eyes sits on a stall in the Faceless City, brown and blue and green, packed in clear oil. As you pass, every one of them turns in the jar to follow you. The stallholder, who has none, smiles.

options.label: Buy one of the eyes, and see what it sees.

outcomes.text: It sees things you cannot, turning in its little box to show you.
It sees you, then tells someone what it saw. They come to find you.

options.label: The strongest smashes the jar. Nothing should watch you like that.

outcomes.text: Oil, glass and eyes spill across the cobbles. In the silence that follows, every faceless head in the street turns your way.

options.label: Cover the jar, and walk on, and try to forget them.

outcomes.text: They keep looking through the cloth. All through the next fight the Leader feels them on the back of the neck, as do the things they fight.

options.label: The keen-eyed one stares back, unwilling to be watched by a jar.

outcomes.text: The jar blinks first. Whatever it was looking for, it will not find it in them again.
